scope: DRAFT unseen evaluation set three (ADR 0009), not frozen. Labels were authored from the production contract (docs/ask-contract.md, docs/ask-stage2.md, docs/ask-stage3.md, ADRs 0004, 0005, 0011-0014, server/ask/models) without running any interpreter, lookup or provider, and without reading evaluation results. It REQUIRES independent human label review before freezing; debatable labels are tagged 'debatable' and listed in docs/verification/ask-unseen-three-label-notes.md. Not yet exposed to any model run. 179 cases: accept 140, clarify 18, unsupported 21. Per family: game_search 22 (accept 17, clarify 3, unsupported 2); boxscore_stat 24 (accept 18, clarify 3, unsupported 3); playoff_series 19 (accept 16, clarify 2, unsupported 1); postseason_summary 20 (accept 18, clarify 1, unsupported 1); player_season_stats 25 (accept 18, clarify 4, unsupported 3); team_records 20 (accept 16, clarify 2, unsupported 2); season_leaders 23 (accept 18, clarify 2, unsupported 3); career_stats 26 (accept 19, clarify 1, unsupported 6).
